name: Proposal & quote builder
tagline: A branded, correctly-priced proposal PDF in two minutes.
who: A landscaper quoting a commercial property — today it is 90 minutes of copy-pasting last quote in Word.
how: Learns your price list and past proposals once; then "quote for Oakridge Plaza — weekly mowing, spring cleanup" produces a branded PDF with correct line-item math, terms, and attachments.
